dedupe_keys.name: stiptheid per type trein en per moment

description: Stiptheid per type trein en per moment is a dataset listed in Infrabel open data portal, an open data portal of a railway infrastructure manager, published or maintained by Infrabel. Maandelijkse stiptheid per type trein (IC, S, P, L) en per moment (ochtend- en avondspits, daluren en weekend). Het stiptheidspercentage geeft aan hoeveel procent van alle binnenlandse treinen, over een periode van een maand, met een vertraging van maximaal 5 minuten en 59 seconden, aangekomen zijn in hun eindbestemmingsstation. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Traffic beheer. Its keywords are Stiptheid, Reizigers, Binnenlandse treinen. The portal shows 2025-11-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-infrabel-open-data-portal.
